_comment: UCU SLAM Dataset v1 calibration facts needed by ORB-SLAM3. Copied (not re-measured) from the dataset repo ucu-autonomous-ugv/ucu-slam-dataset, pinned commit f46dfd6135a75af9da64a759c44928856a3d5b7d, files calibration/calibration.yaml and calibration/raw/{camchain-imucam.yaml,imu.yaml,results-imucam.txt}. scripts/orbslam3/test_orbslam3.py compares this file with those sources when they are present on the PC.
T_cam_imu_note: Kalibr camchain-imucam.yaml cam0/T_cam_imu = T_ci (IMU -> camera). Numerically identical to calibration.yaml T_base_color, which the dataset names as if it were base<-color, i.e. the dataset naming is inverted (old-dvpo/CONVENTIONS.md). ORB-SLAM3 IMU.T_b_c1 must be camera -> body = T_ic = inverse(T_cam_imu); the settings generator computes it. IMU frame == base_link (T_base_imu = I).
T_ic_kalibr_report_note: 'T_ic (cam0 to imu0)' as printed (8 decimals) in calibration/raw/results-imucam.txt. Used only as a cross-check of the inverse in the stub tests.
timeshift_note: Kalibr t_imu = t_cam + shift. Already applied by the official exporter (old-dvpo/CONVENTIONS.md section 3): do NOT shift timestamps again. Informational only.

imu.units: continuous-time Kalibr densities: noise [unit/sqrt(Hz)], random walk [unit/s/sqrt(Hz)]; accel m/s^2, gyro rad/s. ORB-SLAM3 scales them itself (Tracking.cc: Ng*sqrt(freq), Ngw/sqrt(freq)).
